full_prompt_en: A square, thickly brushed landscape painting shows two horseback riders seen from behind on a narrow rocky overlook, facing a vast red-rock canyon beneath a bright blue sky. The sky occupies a shallow upper band filled with clustered white clouds tinged pink and lavender. Below it, a long far rim stretches horizontally across the frame; repeated cliffs and terraces descend from that rim into cool blue-violet depth. Warm red, coral, orange, and dusty rose faces of rock catch direct sunlight, while shadowed cuts and ravines turn deep indigo and purple. On the left foreground, a rugged sunlit rock wall and dark green shrubs frame the overlook. A second high rock mass at the right edge encloses the view, making the central chasm feel even deeper. Near the lower middle, one rider in a pale hat and blue shirt sits on a chestnut horse, slightly ahead and to the right. Another rider in warmer brown clothing follows to the left on a darker horse. Both face away from the viewer, and the animals stand on a small pale stone projection over the drop. The sunlit top of the ledge forms a bright focal path beneath them; beyond, the canyon opens into many overlapping layers and a winding dark central depth. Short, visible strokes and broken color patches give rock, foliage, and sky an impressionist shimmer. Light from the high left brightens the ledge, upper cliff faces, and cloud edges, while lower recesses remain saturated cool shadow. Tiny green accents in shrubs temper the dominant warm rock and blue atmosphere. There is no readable text. The overall composition places two small still figures between close framing rocks and immense layered distance, making the vivid landscape both inviting and awe-inspiring.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形厚笔触风景画呈现两名骑马者背对观者站在狭窄岩石观景处，望向蓝色天空下广阔的红岩峡谷。天空占据上方较浅的一带，成簇白云染着粉色和薰衣草紫。其下，一道漫长的远处崖缘横贯画幅；反复出现的悬崖和台地从那里层层降入冷蓝紫色纵深。暖红、珊瑚、橙色和灰玫瑰色岩面接住直射阳光，阴影中的裂隙与谷地则化为深靛蓝和紫色。左侧前景，崎岖的受光岩壁与深绿色灌木框住观景处。右边缘另一块高岩体围合视野，使中央深谷更显深邃。下部中央附近，一名戴浅色帽、穿蓝上衣的骑手坐在栗色马上，稍靠前偏右。另一名穿暖棕衣服的骑手骑较深色的马，从左侧跟上。两人都背向观者，马站在突出于落差之上的小块浅色石面上。岩沿被阳光照亮的顶部在他们下方形成明亮的焦点路径；往后，峡谷展开为众多重叠层次和中央蜿蜒的暗色纵深。短促可见的笔触与断裂色块让岩石、枝叶和天空带有印象派式闪烁。来自左上方的光照亮岩沿、悬崖上部表面及云边，较低的凹处保留饱和冷影。灌木里的细小绿色重音缓和以暖岩石与蓝色空气为主的配色。画面没有可读文字。整体构图把两名微小静止人物放在近处框景岩石与宏大的层叠远方之间，使鲜艳的景观既令人向往又令人敬畏。
style_prompt_en: The landscape painting uses short, broken brushstrokes and saturated neighboring colors to make sunlit planes vibrate. Warm coral, orange, rose, and ocher occupy broad exposed areas, while blue-violet and indigo settle into recesses; small green accents bridge the two color families. Layers diminish through cool atmospheric shifts rather than strict sharp outlines, giving a large space a readable sequence of near, middle, and far forms. Bright irregular highlights sit on upper edges and protrusions, whereas deeper cuts keep dense chromatic shadow. Dark textured masses on the sides frame a luminous central opening, and a tiny focal silhouette establishes scale without dominating the view. Clouds and rough surfaces share a visibly painted, dappled finish. The overall effect is expansive, colorful, and sun-warmed, with energetic mark-making holding the many spatial layers together.
style_prompt_zh: 这种风景绘画用短而断续的笔触及相邻的饱和色，使受光平面闪烁。暖珊瑚、橙色、玫瑰和赭黄覆盖宽阔的外露区域，蓝紫与靛蓝沉入凹处；小块绿色重音连接两类颜色。层次通过冷调空气变化逐渐缩小，而非依靠严格锐利的轮廓，使广大的空间呈现清楚的近、中、远顺序。明亮不规则高光落在上方边缘和突出部分，较深的切面则保留浓厚有色阴影。两侧的深色肌理体量框住明亮的中央开口，微小焦点剪影建立尺度，却不压过视野。云与粗糙表面共享可见的绘画笔触和斑驳完成度。整体效果开阔、鲜艳、带着阳光温度，充满活力的笔痕把众多空间层次连接起来。
theme_en: Two riders looking across a sunlit red-rock canyon
theme_zh: 两名骑手眺望阳光下的红岩峡谷
name: David Lloyd Glover
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
